name: Battle Pass System
description: XP progression with rewards and a client addon (/bp, /battlepass).

patches.replace: -- require removed: CSMH_SMH.ext is auto-loaded by ALE before .lua scripts; requiring it double-loads CSMH and crashes the server

sql.note: tables must exist BEFORE the server starts

sql.statement: UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{enabled}' WHERE config_key='enabled'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{max_level}' WHERE config_key='max_level'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{exp_per_level}' WHERE config_key='exp_per_level'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{exp_scaling}' WHERE config_key='exp_scaling'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{npc_entry}' WHERE config_key='npc_entry'; UPDATE battlepass_config SET config_value='{debug_mode}' WHERE config_key='debug_mode';

DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry=90100; INSERT INTO creature_template (entry, name, subname, minlevel, maxlevel, faction, npcflag, unit_class, unit_flags, type, AIName, ScriptName) VALUES (90100, 'Battle Pass Vendor', 'Battle Pass', 80, 80, 35, 1, 1, 512, 7, '', '');
sql.note: NPC 90100 is NOT in upstream SQL; wow-manage.sh inserts it (schema-adaptive display 25478 via creature_template_model or modelid1, 6834-6946). Worldserver restart required before .npc add — creature_template is not hot-loaded.

npcs.name: Battle Pass Vendor
npcs.note: Spawn manually after a restart: .npc add 90100
